publicCopy.titleZh: 报道称 LG CNS 将为 Naver Cloud 部署直接芯片液冷
publicCopy.titleEn: Report says LG CNS is deploying direct-to-chip cooling for Naver Cloud
publicCopy.summaryZh: 据 DCD 转述 Korea Herald 报道，LG CNS 正在韩国高阳市 Samsong 数据中心安装直接芯片液冷系统，用于支持 Naver Cloud 计划部署的 NVIDIA Vera Rubin AI 系统；截至本轮 cutoff，核心部署主张尚未获得项目方一手确认。
publicCopy.summaryEn: DCD, citing the Korea Herald, reports that LG CNS is installing direct-to-chip liquid cooling at the Samsong data center in Goyang, South Korea, for Naver Cloud's planned NVIDIA Vera Rubin systems. The core deployment claim lacked primary confirmation by this cutoff.

publicCopy.titleZh: 多家媒体称 Anthropic 与 Nscale 达成算力容量协议
publicCopy.titleEn: Reports say Anthropic reached a $45B compute-capacity agreement with Nscale
publicCopy.summaryZh: DCD 与 Financial Times 分别报道，Anthropic 拟在六年内租用 Nscale 西弗吉尼亚州园区 460MW 容量，协议价值约 $45 billion；DCD 称已向 Nscale 求证，截至本轮 cutoff 尚无一手确认，460MW 的容量口径也未进一步披露。
publicCopy.summaryEn: DCD and the Financial Times separately report that Anthropic would lease 460MW at Nscale's West Virginia campus for six years under an agreement worth about $45 billion. DCD says it sought confirmation from Nscale; no primary confirmation was available by this cutoff, and the 460MW capacity type was not further specified.

publicCopy.titleZh: 报道称数据中心负荷占 PJM 年内批发电价成本的 9%
publicCopy.titleEn: Report says data-center load made up 9% of PJM wholesale power costs through July
publicCopy.summaryZh: Utility Dive 援引 PJM 独立市场监测机构称，2026 年前七个月，现有及预测数据中心负荷经容量市场贡献了 PJM 批发电价的 9%，即 10.48 美元/MWh；该口径不含数据中心带来的电能与输电价格增量，本条尚未在事件包中完成一手报告升级。
publicCopy.summaryEn: Utility Dive cites PJM's independent market monitor as saying existing and forecast data-center load accounted for 9%, or $10.48/MWh, of PJM wholesale power prices through July 2026 via the capacity market. The measure excludes data-center-related energy and transmission price increases; this event packet has not yet been upgraded to the primary report.

publicClaims.qualifier: reported share of PJM wholesale price through July 2026

publicCopy.titleZh: SK 海力士在印第安纳州为 HBM 先进封装基地奠基
publicCopy.titleEn: SK hynix breaks ground on its Indiana HBM advanced-packaging base
publicCopy.summaryZh: SK 海力士官方披露，已在印第安纳州西拉斐特为美国首个 HBM 先进封装基地奠基，计划投资超过 $4 billion，目标在 2028 年 10 月完成无尘室，并于 2029 年下半年启动下一代 HBM 量产。
publicCopy.summaryEn: SK hynix says it has broken ground in West Lafayette, Indiana, on its first U.S. HBM advanced-packaging base. It plans to invest more than $4 billion, complete the cleanroom in October 2028 and begin next-generation HBM mass production in the second half of 2029.

publicCopy.titleZh: 报道称 NVIDIA 拟收购 Hugging Face
publicCopy.titleEn: Report says NVIDIA agreed to acquire Hugging Face for $12.9B
publicCopy.summaryZh: 据 CNBC 转述 The Information 报道，NVIDIA 已同意以 $12.9 billion 收购开源 AI 模型平台 Hugging Face。NVIDIA 与 Hugging Face 截至本轮 cutoff 均未发布一手公告，本条按单一独立来源组的媒体报道呈现。
publicCopy.summaryEn: CNBC, citing The Information, reports that NVIDIA agreed to acquire open-source AI model platform Hugging Face for $12.9 billion. Neither NVIDIA nor Hugging Face had issued a primary announcement by this cutoff, so this remains a single-independent-source-group media report.
